_help: The buff bar at the top right of the HUD: the official favoriteBuff frame (UI/StatusBar3.img/BuffSetting) around the live buff icons. right = the right edge of the bar (the bar grows to the left, the quest tracker sits under it), top = the top edge. iconSize = the skill icon box (32x32), iconPitch = the space between two icons (the official buffIconSpace is 39), pad = the frame thickness (the official corner piece is 5x5). timeRight/timeBottom = the space between the time left and the icon edge.
